Uses of Interface
io.github.jabrena.juno.backend.AsmBackend

Packages that use AsmBackend
Package
Description
io.github.jabrena.juno.backend.avr
The AVR code generator: AvrAsmBackend emits avr-gcc assembly for the ATmega4809 UNO WiFi Rev2, calling the runtime shim through generated word-interface thunks.
io.github.jabrena.juno.backend.thumb2
The Thumb-2 code generator: Thumb2AsmBackend emits GNU ARM Thumb-2 assembly for the Cortex-M4 UNO R4 WiFi and the Cortex-M33 UNO Q, one generator for both cores.
io.github.jabrena.juno.backend.xtensa
The Xtensa code generator: XtensaAsmBackend emits GNU Xtensa assembly for the Nano ESP32's ESP32-S3, calling the runtime shim directly through the windowed-register ABI.

  • Uses of AsmBackend in io.github.jabrena.juno.backend.avr

    Classes in io.github.jabrena.juno.backend.avr that implement AsmBackend
    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    final class 
    AvrAsmBackend
    Emits GNU AVR assembly (avrxmega3, the UNO WiFi Rev2's ATmega4809) straight from Juno IR — the 8-bit counterpart of Thumb2AsmBackend, with the same storage model: every IR value and JVM local lives in a fixed stack slot (see FrameLayout.packed(IrMethod)) and registers are only scratch within one instruction, so a method can never run out of registers.

  • Uses of AsmBackend in io.github.jabrena.juno.backend.thumb2

    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    final class 
    Thumb2AsmBackend
    Emits GNU ARM Thumb-2 assembly straight from Juno IR, restricted to instructions common to the UNO R4's Cortex-M4 and the UNO Q's Cortex-M33, so one code generator serves every board; per-core runtime differences live in CoreRuntime.

    XtensaAsmBackend
    Emits GNU Xtensa assembly (the Nano ESP32's ESP32-S3, an LX7 core) straight from Juno IR, with the storage model of Thumb2AsmBackend: every IR value and JVM local lives in a fixed stack slot (see FrameLayout.packed(IrMethod)) and registers are only scratch within one instruction.
